$comment: Authoritative dependency allowlist (Decision 24d, amended). The repository verification command compares declared dependencies with this allowlist. Every dependency declared in package.json must be present here with a status permitting installation for its implemented use; the installed set may be a subset of the allowlist. Verification rejects: unlisted dependencies; conditionally approved dependencies whose condition is not satisfied; foreign lockfiles; and, where reasonably checkable, packages installed before their corresponding approved implementation exists. It does not require every approved dependency to be installed. The verification tool compares actual package names only, never conceptual capability entries. Versions: latest stable per FW-1 at install, exact via package-lock.json.

statuses.approved: may be installed when its approved implementation is introduced
statuses.conditional: may be installed only after its recorded condition is satisfied
statuses.deferred: may not be installed without a new decision (see docs/decisions/deferred-register.md)

@base-ui/react.note: exact official package name confirmed 2026-07-26 (@base-ui/react; NOT the older @base-ui-components/react, which is pre-release)

server-only.note: install only if the package manager, lint configuration or implementation setup requires the marker package

client-only.note: same condition as server-only; use only where a browser-only non-component module genuinely benefits

drizzle_to_zod_integration.resolved_candidate: drizzle-zod (verified 2026-07-26: latest stable 0.8.3, peer zod ^3.25 || ^4.0, drizzle-orm >=0.36.0)
drizzle_to_zod_integration.note: Exactly one stable Drizzle-to-Zod integration matching the approved stable Drizzle line. At implementation: confirm drizzle-zod is still the stable choice for the installed Drizzle line; add the exact package name to the runtime allowlist in the same reviewed PR that introduces its use; never install both a standalone and a Drizzle-exported integration; never adopt a beta Drizzle-v1 integration for a newer import path.

google_maps_js_loading.note: Official Dynamic Library Import bootstrap (google.maps.importLibrary) contained in the Maps client adapter. No loader dependency; @googlemaps/js-api-loader is governance-gated (deferred register B).

@types/pg.note: only if the selected stable pg version does not supply its own declarations

shadcn.note: pinned exact version; only if retained as a repository dependency rather than an exact-version invocation tool

allow_scripts_rationale.$comment: package.json `allowScripts` approves specific pinned install scripts (npm 11). Approvals are exact identity (name@version) only — never wildcards, never `dangerously-allow-all-scripts`, never auto-extended to future versions. When a resolved version changes, re-review its script deliberately and confirm `npm ci` succeeds under Node 24.
allow_scripts_rationale.sharp@0.34.5: Next.js image-optimizer native library; its install script builds the platform libvips binary. Required for next/image at runtime.
allow_scripts_rationale.unrs-resolver@1.12.2: Native binding for eslint-import-resolver-typescript (pulled by eslint-config-next); its install script builds the resolver binary used by lint's import resolution.
allow_scripts_rationale.fsevents: NOT approved — optional macOS-only file-watcher (via vitest/chokidar). Only affects local watch mode; not needed for verify, build, CI, or Linux (Vercel) deploys, so its install script is left unapproved.

version_gates.$comment: Foundation-time major-version decisions (FW-1 soak posture). 'latest' does not mean the newest major when a newer major is not cleanly supported by the selected Next.js/tooling stack. Each gate lifts only via a reviewed upgrade PR.

node.deferred: 26 — not offered by standard Vercel Builds/Functions yet

typescript.deferred: 7 — native-port compiler API not cleanly supported by the ecosystem without a TS6 compatibility package; would require a dual-compiler/preview-flag setup

eslint.deferred: 10 — eslint-config-next@16.2.12 depends on eslint-plugin-react whose latest (7.37.5) caps at eslint ^9.7 and crashes on ESLint 10 (context.getFilename removed). Lift when eslint-plugin-react/eslint-config-next ship ESLint 10 support.
